user.title: Connect to your FRITZ!Box
user.description: Enter the FRITZ!Box host and a user with telephony permissions. Enable the call monitor first by dialing #96*5* from a connected phone.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the FRITZ!Box. Check the host, TR-064 access, and call monitor on TCP port 1012.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.insufficient_permissions: This FRITZ!Box user does not have permission to access the phonebook.
